regime: Oil shock easing, with metals slipping ahead of the Fed
takeaway: Brent dipped below $115 on Middle East diplomacy, but oil is still high enough to keep inflation worries alive. Gold slipped back toward $4,000, close to a three-month low, and silver fell about three times as much, pushing the gold/silver ratio up to about 75.5. Stock futures pointed a little higher and yields barely moved as the Fed's two-day meeting starts; Wednesday's decision can change this picture quickly.
